metric_definitions.paper_task_SA_P: Symbolically equivalent phenomenal tasks / all planned tasks.
metric_definitions.paper_task_SA_M: Tasks with every planned probe symbolically equivalent / all planned tasks; independent of P.
metric_definitions.legacy_probe_M: Symbolically equivalent individual probes / all planned probes (matches Legacy Core Excel).
metric_definitions.missing_policy: Missing/invalid/error observations contribute zero in derived policy metrics only. Native nulls and original errors are retained.
metric_definitions.strict_complete: Stored result with valid P and every unique planned probe, each with explicit boolean ID/OOD numerical and symbolic flags. False is a valid score.
metric_definitions.symbolic_split_audit: All available train/ID/OOD symbolic flags are explicit booleans and agree; absent flags remain null.
metric_definitions.scope: Three Core80 independent attempts, 20 tasks per domain, 8 original/16 single-variant/56 multiple-variant tasks. Not Full512.
